data.name: microblogPCU
data.abstract: MicroblogPCU data is crawled from sina weibo microblog[http://weibo.com/]. This data can be used to study machine learning methods  as well as do some social network research.

additional_info.summary:
Our dataset is used by us to explore spammers in microblog and you can access our demo system at 
http://sd.skyclass.net/Spammer/dia.jsp

Please add :8080 after the domain name as port. The repository webpage fails to parse the weblink when it's added in the source. (under inspection)
